## "date_pushed_to_specify"

**Data type:**  
String  

**Value:**  
Timestamp of the type: ISO 8601:YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ or null.

**Description of metadata field:**  
This is the date the asset and/or its metadata was initially synced with Specify. 

**Populated by whom and when:**  
ARS when initial sync with specify happens.

**Updated where and when:**  
Never.

**Generated by:**  
ARS.

**Maps to in ARS:**  
None

**Maps to in Specify:**  
None

**Notes and issues:**  
None
